title: Voices Between Two Generations
overview: In the heart of the city, the Panca family is regarded as a blueprint for moral excellence. Mr. Marwano, a charismatic and revered Islamic preacher, has built a legacy on the pillars of piety and order. Beside him is Mrs. Ika, the quiet glue holding the household together. Their sons embody the three paths of success: Hardy, the eldest, is a disciplined civil servant climbing the bureaucratic ladder; Aryaka, the youngest, is a golden boy leading his school's student council; and Nirvan, the middle son, is a brilliant, firebrand university activist.

trailers.title: Suara Diantara Dua Generasi (short move by high five)
